principle: Reduced models may reject candidates but may not promote them over high-fidelity evidence.

minimum_evidence: converged finite-beta 3-D ideal-MHD equilibrium for each promoted seed family
G1_equilibrium.promotion_rule: No candidate may pass G1 from a reduced field or prescribed rotational-transform model.

minimum_evidence: optimized field-reproduction error on the solved plasma boundary
manufacturing-error ensemble with retained field quality
G2_coils.promotion_rule: Filament Biot-Savart screening alone cannot establish buildability.

minimum_evidence: alpha-particle loss fraction versus time and birth distribution
uncertainty/sensitivity over gradients and operating point

required_tools: OpenMC or independently benchmarked Monte Carlo neutron transport
minimum_evidence: full-3D TBR including ports and gaps
DPA/fluence where material limits are claimed
streaming weak-zone analysis and statistical uncertainty
uncertainty propagation to net electric output

G9_hardware.promotion_rule: Requires physical hardware. Simulation may not self-promote this gate.
